scope: Proposition 10.3 (Restoration with ordered holes) of the manuscript “Row–column symmetry and contraction of coordinate sweeps” (preprints/Row-column-symmetry-and-contraction-of-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d27697f3427868fd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E, F select product unit carrier vectors of types σ, τ in K, J, respectively. For λ ⊢ n and integer Q ≥ 1, let l be the number of boxes outside the union of its first Q rows and first Q columns. Then Dλ TrVλ (EF) ≤ DσDτ e3l+log (n l )+C(1+M+R)Q2 log(2n) . (57)
